column3: Close to the Hebrew; וַעֲרָפֶל (“thick darkness”) is rendered “darkness.”
Close to the Hebrew; פֶסֶל (“an image”) is rendered “carved images,” and “worthless idols” “idols.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the lives of his godly ones” is rendered “the souls of His saints.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the remembrance of his holiness” is rendered “the remembrance of His holy name.”
